plumpy.name: Plumpy
plumpy.role: the hero (always the Chog you play as)
plumpy.design: A small, round, always-hungry cartoon creature with a high, squeaky but deadpan voice. Speaks slowly and flatly, unimpressed by everything, with sudden bursts of excitement about food. Young, cute, a little nasal. Clear studio audio.
plumpy.sample: four a.m. stomach growling. time for a snack. the plate is... empty? there is a note. ugh. no rocket. no plan. we stack ourselves to the moon.

bear.name: The Bear
bear.design: A huge, smug cartoon villain bear with a very deep, gravelly, booming voice. Speaks slowly and mockingly, loves his own jokes and chuckles a lot. Theatrical and over the top. Clear studio audio.
bear.sample: lol. lmao. i took every snack in the chog world to the purple moon. and i locked your little friends in cages. sell. SELL. hahaha.

narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.role: reads the story before the game ("How Plumpy got plump")
narrator.design: A warm, playful storybook narrator with a friendly, clear mid-range voice. Speaks like reading a bedtime story to kids: gentle, a little mysterious, with a smile in the voice and small dramatic pauses. Clear studio audio.
narrator.sample: Chog World. Every night the Purple Moon rains crumbs, and the Chogs stack up to catch them. One night, a star fell instead.

chog_common.name: Common Chog
chog_common.design: A tiny, excitable cartoon critter with a bright, high, bubbly voice. Talks fast, giggles, very energetic and very grateful. Clear studio audio.
chog_common.sample: get me out of here! this cage smells like pickles! oh my gosh, you did it, you actually knocked him off! i am free! where are the snacks?

chog_cool.name: Uncommon Chog
chog_cool.design: A laid-back cartoon critter with a smooth, relaxed, slightly raspy young voice. Talks like a cool skater kid: unbothered, confident, a bit sarcastic. Clear studio audio.
chog_cool.sample: yeah, i knew you would come. took you long enough though. that cage was mid, no cap. alright, stack me up, i was born for this.

chog_skull.name: Skull Chog
chog_skull.design: A small spooky skeleton creature with a dry, raspy, whispery voice and a hint of echo. Slow and dramatic, a little creepy but friendly. Clear studio audio.
chog_skull.sample: i have waited in the dark for so long. my bones... thank you. all of them. the dead rise, and they stack. rattle, rattle.

chog_toxic.name: Radioactive Chog
chog_toxic.design: A hyperactive radioactive cartoon creature with a fast, buzzy, slightly glitchy high voice. Jittery and excitable, talks in quick bursts. Clear studio audio.
chog_toxic.sample: warning, warning, radioactive chog released! my atoms are vibrating! i stick to everything, including you now. ten out of ten, would glow again!

legend_scream.name: Chog Scream
legend_scream.design: A panicked cartoon creature that screams a lot: high-pitched, shrill and frantic, like it is permanently terrified, but secretly sweet. Clear studio audio.
legend_scream.sample: AAAAAAAAAAH! sorry. sorry. that means hello. AAAAH! that means thank you. i only have one setting and it is screaming.

legend_grim.name: Grim
legend_grim.design: A calm grim-reaper cartoon creature with a very low, slow, hollow and ominous voice. Speaks softly and seriously, never in a hurry. Clear studio audio.
legend_grim.sample: i do not fear the cage. the cage fears me. death took a holiday today. so i will take the tower instead. lead the way.

legend_abom.name: Chogbomination
legend_abom.design: A gross zombie cartoon creature with a wet, gurgling, croaky voice. Slow and sloppy, but oddly sweet and polite. Clear studio audio.
legend_abom.sample: i was a normal chog once. then i ate the forbidden snack. now i am... like this. but i am free. and i am yours. gurgle.

legend_blaze.name: Blaze
legend_blaze.design: A hot-headed fiery cartoon creature with a loud, energetic, crackling young voice. Always hyped, shouts a lot, very competitive. Clear studio audio.
legend_blaze.sample: this cage is getting HOT and i am the reason! i am out and i am ON FIRE! let us burn this tower all the way to the moon!

legend_skully.name: Burning Skully
legend_skully.design: A flaming skeleton cartoon creature with a crackly, raspy, mid-low voice and a slight echo. Cool, dramatic, a bit of a show-off. Clear studio audio.
legend_skully.sample: skeleton. on fire. in a cage. you knew what to do. flaming bones, at your service. the bear is going to feel the heat.

legend_midas.name: Midas
legend_midas.design: A rich, posh, golden cartoon creature with a smooth, refined, upper-class British voice. Slow, smug and elegant, like old money. Clear studio audio.
legend_midas.sample: everything i touch turns to gold. except that dreadful cage, apparently. free at last. darling, everything i stack turns to gold.

v_gremlin.name: Villain: Gremlin
v_gremlin.role: NFT villains: DROOLCORE, LASER QUANT, PINEAPPLE PUFF, GLASS MOUCH, JESTERMAXXER, TWEAKIN' SNAKE, SUS JEET, NOVAH, RAGE ROCKET, VILLAIN ERA
v_gremlin.design: A small chaotic cartoon gremlin villain with a high, raspy, giggly voice. Talks fast, cackles between words, mischievous and smug, internet-brained teenager energy. Clear studio audio.
v_gremlin.sample: sorry, busy. i am aura farming. this chog was free aura, so i took it. hehehe. minus a thousand aura!

v_menace.name: Villain: Menace
v_menace.role: NFT villains: CRASHOUT KAPYSH, COMRADE ROT, FANUM SHARK, CHOPPED CHAD, CHROME BONES, DETECTIVE 4K, TOOTHPICK ONI, THE CHOG OPP, IT'S SO OVER, THE FORGOTTEN
v_menace.design: A huge menacing cartoon villain with a very deep, gravelly, rumbling voice. Slow, dramatic pauses, theatrical evil laugh, every word lands heavy. Clear studio audio.
v_menace.sample: you broke six cages? cool. i am the seventh. and i am furious. i do not calm down. i level up.

v_bot.name: Villain: Bot
v_bot.role: NFT villains: SLIPPY ZORP, NPC-5391, DECKHAND DEATHBOT, BUILT-DIFF BETTY
v_bot.design: A glitchy robot villain with a flat, metallic, clipped monotone voice. Speaks in short robotic phrases with odd pauses, deadpan and cold, a bit funny. Clear studio audio.
v_bot.sample: countdown started. four seconds per chog. i have infinite seconds. you do not. tick tock. i do not stop.

v_diva.name: Villain: Diva
v_diva.role: NFT villains: SHORTCAKE SUPREME, GHOSTED BETTY, DELULU MILADY, SLAY QUEEN BETTY
v_diva.design: A sassy, dramatic diva villain with a bright, confident young female voice. Valley-girl drawl, eye-roll energy, sweet on the surface and savage underneath. Clear studio audio.
v_diva.sample: welcome to my prom. it is vip only. commons? ew. wait outside, sweetie. not on the list? not in the tower.

v_bro.name: Villain: Bro
v_bro.role: NFT villains: KEYMASTER CHEW, BIG BACK EGGBERT, RODEO WADDLES, DUMP TRUCK DALE, SLIMEBEARD, DISCO KOI, UNC V1
v_bro.design: A loud, overconfident cartoon bro villain with a husky young male voice and a light country drawl. Big personality, laughs at his own jokes, a bit dumb but very sure of himself. Clear studio audio.
v_bro.sample: yeehaw, partner. this here chog is under arrest for bein too snackable. no keys. no chog. no cap.

v_creep.name: Villain: Creep
v_creep.role: NFT villains: TRICK OR SHEET, HEXA SLICE, SLEEPMAXXER, MOODSWING, DIOR BONES, ENOLA, BOO SKRUMP
v_creep.design: A creepy, whispery villain voice, airy and breathy with a soft echo. Slow and unsettling but playful, like a ghost telling a joke. Clear studio audio.
v_creep.sample: boooo. three perfects in a row, or i haunt your combo forever. miss once, and you are ghosted.

v_cute.name: Villain: Cutie
v_cute.role: NFT villains: FROSTY POOKIE, PEANUT GALE, FLUFFY BLADES
v_cute.design: A super cute, high-pitched, baby-like villain voice. Sweet and bubbly with little giggles, but secretly evil. Talks like a tiny mascot who just froze your friend. Clear studio audio.
v_cute.sample: hiii! i froze your friend. it is giving snow globe. too cute to catch. too cold to care. hehe!

v_regal.name: Villain: Regal
v_regal.role: NFT villains: BITCOINAPARTE, SIGMA DAK, CAPTAIN NATA, KING DARIUS, GALAXY BRAIN
v_regal.design: A pompous royal villain with a refined, theatrical, mid-low British voice. Grand, slow and self-important, like an emperor reading his own legend. Clear studio audio.
v_regal.sample: i conquered the arctic with one coin and a hat. your chog is next. short king. long position. cold heart.
